name: AutoFactory AI provider
description: Selects the Phase 1 agent execution backend. Read natively by the runtime; defaults to 'anthropic' when this flag is absent. Variations: 'bedrock' (same agents on Claude via Amazon Bedrock — needs AWS_REGION + AWS credentials), 'vega' (LaunchDarkly-hosted), 'cursor' (Cursor agents via @cursor/sdk — needs CURSOR_API_KEY and the checkout+npm-ci workflow, not the plain drop-in template), and 'openai' (agents on OpenAI Chat Completions — needs OPENAI_API_KEY or CODEX_API_KEY; the Codex surface's default). Provisioned ON with surface-aware rules (ADR 0018): claude-code → anthropic, codex → openai, copilot → anthropic (Copilot cloud agent sandbox; sandbox-confined runner required for working-tree mode), github-action → 50/50 anthropic/cursor per run; fallthrough anthropic. Runners degrade to anthropic when the selected provider's key is absent.

rules.description: Copilot cloud agent surface → Anthropic models (sandbox-confined runner for working-tree mode)
GitHub Action → 50/50 Anthropic/Cursor, bucketed per run
